creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-29: "ability to bring back a specific pane by eg call sign if eg closed accidentally".

A pane closed by mistake is gone along with its agent. Nothing lists closed panes, and getting the conversation back means starting the harness in a new pane and resuming its session by hand, under a new given name and callsign. Wanted: reopen a closed pane by its callsign, from the CLI or a menu, which makes a pane in its directory, resumes its agent's session there with the flags it ran with, and gives back its given name and callsign. `muster pane restart` already resumes a session from what the harness reported, in the same pane; reopening needs the daemon to keep that record after the pane closes.

a_2pP7RbnOl covers getting the name and callsign back when you resume a conversation yourself, and the ⌘W card guards against the accidental close in the first place. Open: how long a closed pane's record is kept, and where the reopened pane goes in the layout.
title: Bring back a pane closed by mistake, by its callsign
